entries.254826ca23ffb17e: A company that operates "BUYMA," a marketplace where fashion items from around the world can be purchased, and "BUYMA TRAVEL," which offers overseas travel experiences.
entries.263774cbfe1bf260: This is a CtoC service in which Japanese residents overseas provide private tours locally to overseas travelers. Guides list plans that make use of their respective areas of expertise, and travelers can also consult with guides to create tailor-made travel plans. It is operated by the consolidated subsidiary BUYMA TRAVEL Inc. (Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo). Revenue is not disclosed for this category separately.
entries.2ecfccf537f575db: "BUYMA" is a CtoC marketplace where users can purchase fashion items from around the world from more than 240,000 personal shoppers (sellers) residing in 185 countries and regions. Because sellers purchase items after an order is placed, they hold no inventory risk, and buyers can find the latest local items and items cheaper than in Japan. As of January 2026, the number of members was approximately 12.01 million, and revenue for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥5,373 million. The company's head office (Minato-ku, Tokyo) is the base of this business.
